upcomingEvent.title: AlgoArena
upcomingEvent.description: AlgoArena is an ICPC-inspired competitive coding event that simulates the pressure and strategy of global programming contests. Spanning 5 hours, it follows a multi-round elimination format with progressively challenging algorithmic problems.

agenda.activity: Opening briefing and contest rules explanation

pastEvents.title: Git & GitHub: The Workshop
pastEvents.description: A hands-on version control workshop for student developers to master Git basics, branching strategies, and open-source collaboration — Waffle-style.

pastEvents.title: CodeIT
pastEvents.description: A high-energy coding sprint focused on beginner-friendly challenges and real-world project mentorship. From HTML to Python, attendees shipped fast and learned faster.

pastEvents.title: Machina Speculatrix
pastEvents.description: A niche robotics + AI discussion meetup inspired by Grey Walter's cybernetic tortoises. Intimate, mind-bending, and surprisingly philosophical.

pastEvents.title: Spontaneous Meetup
pastEvents.description: No stage. No slides. Just raw conversation. A casual builder meet where ideas were born over chai and chaos — the real soul of Waffle.

pastEvents.title: Converge
pastEvents.description: Our biggest event yet — a full-day student-led tech summit featuring lightning talks, mini hackathons, and panels with real founders. Builders from across colleges connected, collaborated, and co-created.

pastEvents.title: Techwiz
pastEvents.description: A one-day showdown of tech trivia, fast-paced challenges, and real-time problem-solving. Techwiz tested not just knowledge, but reflexes and wit.

pastEvents.title: JS Juggernauts
pastEvents.description: A two-day JavaScript bootcamp where students dove into the world of frontend frameworks, DOM magic, and async power. From vanilla JS to React basics — pure coding chaos, the Waffle way.

pastEvents.title: Building BootCamp
pastEvents.description: A transformational boot camp designed to help you find clarity, confidence, and the courage to build what matters. You'll explore your identity, team up with fellow creators, and bring real product ideas to life — from zero to demo

pastEvents.title: UItopia: UI/UX Design Workshop
pastEvents.description: Learn UI/UX. Build Better Designs. 2 day workshop. Discover the art of creating beautiful & user-friendly digital experiences in this hands-on UI/UX workshop.Learn UI & UX fundamentals. Explore design thinking & prototyping. No prior experience needed. Bring your laptop for practical sessions! Don’t miss your chance to level up your design skills!
